audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing structural — EVEN / 6-10 at 53.88% over 464 games, and the phase split already matched the mirror.
audit.why: The mirror (gwen__olaf) set the chart to Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Olaf/Gwen/Gwen/Skill and this side already reads exactly that in both layers, so no rows were touched.
audit.corrected: Chart left alone; the phase reasoning re-anchored to Hallowed Mist's 22/21/20/19/18s and Snip Snip!'s 6.5s down to 3.5s.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] labelled Hallowed Mist an 'R-untargetable' window.
audit.why: The mist is her W, on 22s at rank 1; her R is Needlework, a 1200-range needle that slows and recasts twice. Calling the level-6 swing an R effect points the reader at the wrong cooldown to track.
audit.corrected: Re-slotted to W with the mist's real behaviour, and Needlework left out of the spike entirely.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive Hallowed Mist interaction is stated backwards: 'she's untargetable so your Q and E whiff', 'don't chase her into Mist'.
audit.why: Riot's text: the mist protects her from enemies OUTSIDE of it, and she can only be targeted by enemies who ENTER it. For a melee run-down champion the mist is a place to walk into, not a wall — backing off is what makes her free.
audit.corrected: Rewritten in whys[4], spikes[2], mid and wants.foe[0] to say the mist blocks outsiders and that stepping in is the answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Q was written 'Snip Snip' — flagged by the packet as a near-miss.
audit.why: The real name is Snip Snip!, and it deals TRUE damage in the centre of the cone, which is why armour reads on this matchup are misleading in both directions.
audit.corrected: Name fixed and the true-damage centre noted where it fits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings give Olaf's W omnivamp ('W-sustain', 'W-omnivamp', 'Your W omnivamp').
audit.why: Tough It Out is attack speed plus a shield; the lifesteal is the passive and scales with missing health.
audit.corrected: Shield and healing split to the right sources throughout.

audit.whatIsWrong: Whether Undertow denies Skip 'n Slash is left unclaimed.
audit.why: The kit file tags Undertow with grounding, but Riot's description mentions only damage, armour reduction and a slow. Same call the mirror made — a grounding axe would rewrite every escape line in this matchup, so it needs a human check rather than a guess.

edits.after: Undertow her as she steps up, walk the pickup to reset its 9s, then Reckless Swing — Tough It Out shields her answer.

edits.before: Axe-slow + W sustain wins the first trades. Identify how Gwen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Undertow's slow into an auto wins first contact — no Hallowed Mist yet, and Skip 'n Slash is her only way out.

edits.before: Axe-slow + W sustain wins the first trades. Respect Gwen's Hallowed Mist completely — the first levels are about banking small advantages, not proving a point.
edits.after: Undertow's slow and Tough It Out's shield win the first trades, before Hallowed Mist exists at all — these levels are about banking leads, not proving a point.

edits.after: Your axe-reset perma-slow and missing-health lifesteal out-last her poke — she cannot kite a slowed target.

edits.before: Her W Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable so your Q and E whiff, and Ragnarok's CC-immunity does nothing to her healing.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist only blocks enemies outside it — step in and she is targetable again, but her Snip Snip! is free in there.

edits.before: Q-reset perma-slow plus W-omnivamp out-sustains her Q true-damage poke in short trades.
edits.after: Axe-reset perma-slow and missing-health lifesteal out-last her Snip Snip! poke in short trades.

edits.before: Her R-untargetable Mist window: she snaps her Snip Snip Q off inside it where Ragnarok's CC-immunity does nothing to her healing — her biggest swing.
edits.after: Her W window: Hallowed Mist blocks everyone standing outside it, so she snips Snip Snip! from safety unless you walk in — her biggest swing at 6.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still yours: Q-reset perma-slow plus W-omnivamp eats her Q true-damage poke in any short fight, and she can't kite a slowed target out of your auto range yet. The lane flips at 6 — her Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable, so your Q axe and E nuke whiff while she heals and Q-true-damages you from inside it; Ragnarok's CC-immunity is wasted because Gwen barely relies on CC. Don't chase her into Mist; bait her out of it or wait the ~5s window.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still yours: the axe reset perma-slows her and your missing-health lifesteal eats her Snip Snip! poke in any short fight, and she cannot kite a slowed target out of auto range yet. The lane flips at 6 — Hallowed Mist only stops enemies who stay outside it, so from range your axe finds nothing while she snips and heals. The answer is to step in, not to back off: walk into the mist and Reckless Swing her, or wait its 22s out.

edits.before: You built your whole game on the early lead, because late is hers. Stacked Riftmaker and Nashor's AP through Mist means her Snip Snip true damage and per-cent burst out-scale your flat E and short-fight kit. Your W omnivamp can't out-heal a fed Gwen, and she just W's untargetable when you commit Ragnarok. Close the game on your timers — towers, dives, objectives — before her two items come online, or this becomes unwinnable.
edits.after: You built your whole game on the early lead, because late is hers. Stacked Riftmaker and Nashor's AP through the mist means Snip Snip!'s true damage and per-cent burst out-scale your flat kit. Your lifesteal cannot keep up with a fed Gwen, and she re-mists the moment you commit Ragnarok. Close the game on your timers — towers, dives, objectives — before her two items come online, or this becomes unwinnable.

edits.after: Bait out Skip 'n Slash and her Q poke, then heal the trade back and re-slow off the axe pickup

edits.after: Sit in Hallowed Mist so you must step inside to touch her while she snips away

notes: The Hallowed Mist advice was inverted. The page told the reader not to chase her into the mist; Riot's text says the mist only protects her from enemies OUTSIDE it and that entering makes her targetable — so for Olaf, walking in is the play and standing off is what gives her a free window. Fixed in four strings. Also: the mist was called an R effect in spikes[2] and the Q was written 'Snip Snip' instead of 'Snip Snip!'. Level chart untouched — it already matches the mirror in both layers, though note it disagrees with the packet chart on rows 1, 2, 3 and 5; the mirror was treated as authoritative.
